payload.title: MCSP and THR2 original generator fixture and certificate-gap archive
payload.body:
# MCSP and THR2 original generator fixture and certificate-gap archive

87 exact original files, including 57 code sources. This artifact-check REVIEW preserves source/input provenance and records the precise reproduction boundaries around the existing indexed RESULT. It is inconclusive about mathematical validity; no research code was executed.

MCSP/THR2 generators, local modules, expected fixtures and historical checksum records are preserved. MCSP928 lacks its three original JSON inputs. Three SAT bundles lack their 26 compressed certificates in this public edition, totaling150385201bytes; four exceed8MiB. A generator workflow is not preservation of absent historical inputs. Expected fixtures and printed checks are not observed new runs. These materials do not certify actual RW witnesses or resolve P versus NP.

Raw code, fixtures, checksum-bound specifications, JSON prefixes/tails and expected records are preserved without banners or reformatting. Scientific and licence declarations live in sidecars. A file named certificate, a stored PASS or a published algorithm is not new independent proof acceptance.

Li Hongmin is the authorized human contributor; original drafting/checking was AI-assisted, with source-model identity not independently reconstructed. Codex performed static archival review and packaging. Own code Apache-2.0; original text/data CC BY 4.0; cited third-party passages retain source rights.
